newsitem.title: USA: Wash. Water Power in alliance with Mock.
newsitem.headline: Wash. Water Power in alliance with Mock.

text.p: Washington Water Power Co said Thursday said it has joined forces with Mock Energy Services, a California natural gas marketer.

Mock Energy, a partnership that includes Conoco, a subsidiary of DuPont, holds a market share of around 25 percent of California's direct access natural gas customers, the Washington utility said in a statement.
The two companies said they will jointly market electric commodity service and other energy products to industrial and large commercial customers throughout Calfiornia.

Washington Water Power Co (WWP) had been expected to pursue an alliance or joint venture with a marketer or utility since its proposed merger with Sierra Pacific Resources, based in Reno, Nev., fell through earlier this year.
The combined electric and gas utility currently has retail operations in five western states and is aggressively pursuing wholesale power marketing opportunities.
Conoco in April purchased a majority stake in the natural gas marketing division of Mock Resources, an Irvine, Calif.-based marketer of petroleum products, to form Mock Energy Services.

WWP and Mock said they will also offer customers a wide variety of energy related products and services like real-time metering, consolidated billing, energy technology services and energy commodity management through WWP's subsidiary, WWP Energy Solutions.
"We view this as an excellent long-term, strategic partnership for our company," said Gary Ely, WWP's senior vice president for energy trading and market services.

The alliance's joint marketing efforts will be conducted by staff from both companies utilizing Mock's Irvine and Pleasanton, Calif., offices as bases of operations for northern and southern California marketing efforts.
